nom: Dermalogica Biolumin-C Vitamin C Eye Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one with blepharitis and another who also uses the brand's eye-safe exfoliator, report no irritation or negative reaction from the serum; one of them, however, found it peeled off under makeup and never seemed to fully absorb.
segments.dry: One reviewer whose eyes run very dry says the serum's thin, watery consistency doesn't provide enough moisture on bad days and needs to be paired with a heavier eye cream.

concerns.spots: Reports on dark circles are sharply split: many reviewers describe a dramatic, sometimes rapid lightening — including one who had to switch to a lighter concealer shade — while a comparable number say they saw no visible brightening even after two or more weeks of consistent use and would not repurchase at the price. One reviewer also noted it lightened two dark sun spots near her eye.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as lightweight but genuinely hydrating, absorbing quickly without feeling greasy or heavy; a couple of reviewers with drier under-eye skin felt it wasn't moisturizing enough on its own and layered it with a richer eye cream.
concerns.aging: Many reviewers report softer fine lines and crow's feet with continued use, and several mention improved firmness or a more youthful look around the eyes; some note this takes several weeks of regular use to become noticeable.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reported breakouts around her eyes after using the serum, while another specifically noted it did not cause any breakouts for her.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reported the serum made redness around her eyes disappear within a day, alongside lightening her dark circles.

aspects.libelle: Tube can release a wasteful big glob
Airtight tube keeps product from air exposure
A little product goes a long way
Wear under makeup is inconsistent between users

extraits.texte: Was disappointed at the breakout around my eyes, for a product designed to put around your eyes. Was pricey too!

So i think it did brighten my under eye area very slightly but unfortunately I did not notice a huge difference. I think I expected for my dark circles to lighten drastically and that did not occur. Overall for the price I spent, I can not recommend this product to anyone else. I also do not use everyday but more like 2x a week due to the fact I started to notice milia underneath my eye getting larger.

I have enjoyed using this eye cream for almost a year now. I love the lightweight moisture that it provides, and it doesn't irritate my extremely sensitive eyelids (I have blepharitis). However, I am going to be looking for a new eye product because unfortunately, this is unwearable under makeup and tinted moisturizers. It peels off under them, even if they're applied to my skin hours after putting on the serum. This leads me to believe that it's not getting fully absorbed. This serum is too expensive to only be able to wear it at night. And, for the price, I feel it should be more brightening. Also, too much product comes out even with the gentlest squeeze. This is great for nighttime, but I won't be using it anymore.

The prduct works really well! I use both morning and night and saw the brightening effects of it relatively quickly. Maybe about two weeks? It is quite a loose consistency, more like a serum. My only con would be is that my eyes get super dry (not from the product) but because of the consistency it doesn't moisturize as much as I need it to on my really bad days. I pair it with the Good Molecules brightening eye cream for the bad days and they both go on wonderfully together. Would definitely recommend. This can be your only eye product as long as you dont struggle with dry eyes like me. :)

This eye serum is absolutely fantastic. I have uneven, Indian, 40-year-old eyes with classically dark circles under my eyes. This serum is literally the only product I have ever used that lightened up the circles. I keep it in my mini beauty fridge to keep it cold, and I press the bottle very lightly to get a half-pea sized drop for both eyes. BE CAREFUL WHEN PRESSING THE BOTTLE because a huge glob WILL come out and that's a total waste. This product lightened my under-eyes to the point where I had to select a different shade of concealer. It's amazing! I wait a minute or so for the product to absorb, then I follow up with an eye cream, day and night.

I have naturally dark skin around my eyes from genetics and it's always been an insecurity. I was recommended this product and was very skeptical, and also was nervous about taking a risk on something so pricey. But I'm so glad I did! Don't get me wrong, I still have darker skin around my eyes, but it's atleast 3xs lighter and I no longer look like I have "raccoon eyes." I've also been using dermalogica's exfoliator (safely around my eyes and I have sensitive skin) that may be helping as well. Regardless, I noticed extreme results within about a week and a half.

The biolumin-c serum is remarkable, it made my dark circles and redness completely disappear in a matter of a day. I love this serum so much, I wish I had started using it sooner. It is now a staple in my dermalogica lineup!
